Hi Aisha —

Thanks again for taking the time to demo your clinical summarization workflow today. Quick recap and next steps from our side so we keep momentum with Compliance and the ML team: 

1) Model recommendations & rationale
- Recommended baseline: redwood-llama-70b-q4 (best mix of clinical fidelity + throughput for your expected 400–800 tokens summaries).
- Fallback: redwood-alpaca-13b-int8 for lower-cost batch processes (if you need predictable throughput during peak ingestion).

2) Evals & benchmark links
- Shared a lightweight eval project (public link below) with the exact prompt sets we discussed — covers hallucination, factuality on patient notes, and refusal behavior on PSI/PII requests.
- Eval dashboard: https://app.redwood.ai/evals/HS-2026-0821

3) Safety/refusal behavior focus
- We will run targeted guardrail tests for: requests to synthesize patient-identifiable info, instructions to bypass clinical disclaimers, and prompts that try to elicit treatment recommendations in edge cases.
- Example guardrail prompt set: see Drive folder (link below).

4) Data & access asks (needed to run quality + safety evals)
- A redacted sample of ~200 notes (PHI removed) or a synthetic equivalent.
- A short rubric from your clinical SME (we can use our template if you prefer).

5) Timeline & next meeting
- We can kick off an initial model-fit run + safety sweep next week if we get the sample by EOD Friday. Proposed follow-up: 30-min sync on Wed 9/23 to review early results.

Attachments: healthscope-safety-eval-plan.pdf (high-level plan + milestones)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExamplePromptSets
HubSpot: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/HS-2026-0821

Appreciate any constraints from your side (SLA, retention, or gov/reg requirements) so we can flag them in the evals.

Thanks —

Hi Aisha / Marissa —

Thanks for the context — happy to own the one-page guardrail summary for Compliance. Draft outline below (I can convert to a PDF/slide and drop in the Drive):

- Scope: refusal on PSI/PHI extraction, clinical-treatment deflection, hallucination on medication/dosage, and prompt-injection attempts.
- Metrics: refusal rate, false-accept rate (accept that should be refused), hallucination F1 (against annotated ground truth), and average tokens-to-decision for refusal heuristics.
- Tests: 150 adversarial prompts (edge-case clinical phrasing), 200 redacted notes checks, and 50 prompt-injection variants.
- Pass criteria: false-accept rate < 2%, hallucination F1 > 0.85 in core entities, refusal latency < 250ms median for single-shot requests.

I also attached a small CSV stub with a sample test row and expected result format: safety-eval-results-stub.csv

If you can share the redacted notes (or synthetic set) I will queue up the initial sweep on redwood-llama-70b-q4 and redwood-alpaca-13b-int8 and share early artifacts to the eval dashboard.

Rafael Mendes
Head of Model Safety | Redwood Inference
